pipelines.name: Build and push images to ghcr.io/zulip/zulip-server

steps.name: Get commit SHA for current 13.x tip
steps.run:
COMMIT=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/zulip/zulip.git refs/heads/13.x | cut -f1)
echo "override=ZULIP_GIT_REF=$COMMIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Create manifest list and push
steps.run:
set -x
IFS=$'\n'
ANNOTATIONS_LIST=($DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_ANNOTATIONS)
TAGS_LIST=($DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_TAGS)
docker buildx imagetools create \
  $(for tag in "${TAGS_LIST[@]}"; do echo "--tag"; echo "$tag"; done) \
  $(for annotation in "${ANNOTATIONS_LIST[@]}"; do echo "--annotation"; echo "$annotation"; done) \
  $(for reference in *; do printf "${PACKAGE_NAME}@sha256:%s\n" $reference; done)

steps.name: Create or update GitHub release
steps.run:
title="Zulip Server $TAG"
if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gh release edit "$TAG" --title "$title" --notes-file release-notes.md
else
  gh release create "$TAG" \
    --title "$title" \
    --notes-file release-notes.md \
    --verify-tag
fi

pipelines.name: Dockerfile lint and build

steps.name: Get commit SHA for current 13.x tip
steps.run:
COMMIT=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/zulip/zulip.git refs/heads/13.x | cut -f1)
echo "commit_sha=$COMMIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Run prettier over the re-generated docs
Check for any diff
steps.run:
if ! git diff HEAD --exit-code; then
  echo "Changes found!"
  git status
  git diff HEAD
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Helm lint and kubeconform
steps.run:
for f in helm/zulip/ci/*-values.yaml; do
  helm lint helm/zulip/ --strict -f "$f"

  helm template test-release helm/zulip/ -f "$f" \
    | kubeconform -strict -summary \
        -kubernetes-version 1.32.0 \
        -ignore-missing-schemas
done

steps.name: Load image into kind
steps.run:
docker load --input /tmp/image.tar
kind load docker-image zulip/zulip-server:pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --name helm-test

steps.name: Install chart
steps.run:
helm install zulip helm/zulip/ \
  -f "helm/zulip/ci/${{ matrix.values }}" \
  --set image.tag=pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} \
  --wait --timeout 10m

steps.name: Run functional tests
steps.run:
pod=$(kubectl get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=zulip -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl port-forward svc/zulip 8080:80 &
PF_PID=$!
# Wait for port-forward to be ready
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health \
       -H "Host: zulip.example.net"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done
helm/zulip/ci/test.sh "$pod" 8080
kill $PF_PID || true

steps.name: Fetch logs
steps.run:
kubectl get pods
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -o name); do
    kubectl describe "$pod"
done
pod=$(kubectl get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=zulip --output name)
kubectl logs "$pod"
kubectl exec "$pod" -c zulip -- cat /var/log/zulip/errors.log

steps.name: Wait for services to be healthy
steps.run:
echo "Waiting for zulip service to be healthy..."
until docker inspect --format "{{.State.Health.Status}}" $(docker compose ps -q zulip) | grep -q healthy; do sleep 5; done

steps.name: Verify all services are running
steps.run:
docker compose logs zulip
docker compose ps
# Check that no services are in a failed state
if docker compose ps | grep -E "(Exit|Restarting)"; then
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Check service logs for critical errors
steps.run:
docker compose ps
docker compose logs zulip

pipelines.name: Push Helm chart to ghcr.io/zulip/helm-charts/zulip

steps.name: Validate tag matches Chart.yaml version
steps.run:
set -eu
tag_version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#helm-}"
chart_version="$(yq '.version' helm/zulip/Chart.yaml)"
if [ "$tag_version" != "$chart_version" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag version ($tag_version) does not match Chart.yaml version ($chart_version)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=$chart_version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Package and push chart
steps.run:
set -eu
helm package helm/zulip
helm push "zulip-${VERSION}.tgz" oci://ghcr.io/zulip/helm-charts
